column2: CONTEXT SWEEP 2026-09-12 - body x rung ladder.  Card = RTX 5090 sm_120, 32,607 MiB.
VRAM is RAW nvidia-smi MiB, never divided by 1000 (house rule). vram_free = 32607 - vram_mib.
METHOD: llama-server invoked DIRECTLY with each body's canonical start_server.sh flags,
varying only --ctx-size (+ the offload/KV knobs named per body). The start scripts were NOT
used to launch, because they source their env files and would override inherited vars.
Rig: rung.sh + bodies.sh in this directory. Per-rung logs in logs/.
decode_tps = best of 2 WARM reps on a ~200-token prose generation; a throwaway warm-up
request precedes them, so the cold first request is never what gets recorded.
long_* = one ~21K-token synthetic ledger prompt (probes/longdoc.txt) with a needle
(MARGATE-4471-QUINCE) planted in entry 0001. needle=HIT means the model quoted it back,
which is what proves a rung actually HOLDS long context rather than merely allocating for it.
source: sweep = measured by this sweep. earlier-0912 = measured earlier the same night by the
the gate checks (cited, not re-run). ladder-0903 = the Qwen3-235B D2 ladder.
CAVEAT: a 97 GB hf download (unsloth GLM-4.7 UD-IQ1_S) ran throughout, competing for NVMe
bandwidth and page cache. It can only have slowed loads, so every load_s below is an upper
bound. VRAM and t/s figures are unaffected.
